reddit.title: Improving Performance with Flowing Water in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the performance of flowing lakes in Provincia. By optimizing the way water presence is managed, we've reduced the script time for a 64×64 lake from around 20 ms to just 12 ms. This means smoother gameplay and less lag during your city-building adventures. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/cutting-flowing-water-cost?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=cutting-flowing-water-cost
